contents.name: MaxMerkleTreeDepth
contents.description: Maximum depth of the binary merkle-tree used for proof generation (e.g. 12). Value used as 2^MerkleTreeDepth.
contents.comment: Proofs allows to verify integrity and origin of the stream. A proof represents a binary-merkle-tree and 2^MerkleTreeDepth values are necessary to build a single proof.

contents.name: MaxMerkleTreeAge
contents.description: Maximum merkle tree age in seconds (e.g. 600).
contents.comment: If a stream doesn't provides enough values to build an entire merkle tree with the given depth in the given time-period it will be splitted into smaller merkle trees.
